query: CREATE TABLE `redistricting_states` (`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL, `state_code` varchar(2) NOT NULL, `state_name` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `enacted` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, `reason` text, `status` varchar(128), `method` varchar(128), `delegation_before` varchar(64), `projected_impact` varchar(64), `litigation_notes` text, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT `redistricting_states_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`), CONSTRAINT `redistricting_states_state_code_unique` UNIQUE(`state_code`)); CREATE TABLE `referendums` (`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL, `state_code` varchar(2) NOT NULL, `state_name` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `name` varchar(256) NOT NULL, `description` text, `yes_label` varchar(128) DEFAULT 'Yes', `no_label` varchar(128) DEFAULT 'No', `yes_votes` bigint DEFAULT 0, `no_votes` bigint DEFAULT 0, `pct_reporting` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT '0', `election_date` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `status` enum('Scheduled','Voting','Called','Certified') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Scheduled', `called_result` enum('Yes','No'), `notes` text, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT `referendums_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
